source_snapshot.procedure: Capture health, shutdown to S5, infer off by ping loss, issue IPMI power on, run Post-Boot Stress/Basic Health/dmesg/RAS, repeat 100 cycles.
source_snapshot.criteria: Power-cycle completion, 100 recommended, no lock/MCE/kernel error/health mismatch/Post-Boot failure.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; treats true DC as physical human-only, but does not resolve the source's S5/IPMI semantics.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; owner must resolve physical DC versus S5, with operator safety and complete per-cycle evidence.

old_problem: DC-cycle identity conflicts with a Procedure that only enters logical S5 and sends IPMI power-on. Ping loss is not electrical proof, 100 is both repeated and recommended, logs are cleared, and plaintext IPMI plus no operator/recovery contract is unsafe.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending, Source Conflict and MANUAL ONLY. ED-06/ED-09/ED-14/ED-18/ED-19 prohibit equating S5 with physical DC or letting an agent perform physical power work. Only the exact platform owner can define which rails must drop and the accepted count. A complete operator-controlled draft preserves boot, stress, health and RAS coverage and closes unsafe automation paths.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2068, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2069 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00023-V002 / 7a141eb517697292 was directly read from XLSX and locked queue.
ACPI S5 is logical soft-off and can leave auxiliary/standby DC present; network silence proves reachability loss, not rail removal.
True physical DC control is operator-owned and requires exact rail/controller, discharge and restore evidence plus a path that survives loss of management power.
The body repeats 100 times while Criteria says recommended; accepted count cannot be inferred or shortened to smoke coverage.
Every cycle retains unique power/boot identity, full Basic Health/Post-Boot/RAS/kernel/BMC evidence and stop-on-first-anomaly.
No shutdown, IPMI, physical/DC action, health test, log clear, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Operator-controlled DC or S5 cycle endurance with exact rail and boot evidence — GATE-CLOSED DRAFT
test_case.purpose: After semantic resolution, have a trained operator execute every required approved DC or S5 transition and prove the intended power state, ordered restore, unique healthy boot, passing Post-Boot Stress/Basic Health and no new lock/MCE/RAS/kernel/BMC fault.
required_package: Signed selection of physical DC rail removal/restoration or S5 plus OOB on, and accepted cycle count
Exact rail/controller/off-state/discharge/restore evidence or S5 state oracle
Trained operator, electrical safety authorization, workload/data drain and surviving recovery path
Boot media, unique boot ID/readiness and exact Basic Health/Post-Boot recipes
Complete error policy, immutable cycle ledger and final-state requirements
test_case.test_command: MANUAL GATE CLOSED — AGENT MUST NOT TOGGLE DC. After unlock, preserve baseline. For each numbered cycle the trained operator performs exactly the approved power sequence while independent evidence proves each required state. Protected automation may only correlate operator/OOB events, unique boot ID/readiness, exact health/stress results and complete error deltas. Seal the cycle before advancing and halt on first anomaly. No ping-only off proof, plaintext credentials, log clear, class substitution or retry.
test_case.expected_result: After unlock, every required cycle proves the selected electrical/logical state and ordered restore, the same SUT reaches a unique OS-ready boot with complete GPU/service health, and all stress/health/RAS criteria pass without lock or disallowed error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is possible until power semantics and count are signed. Then PASS requires all operator power-state evidence and all per-cycle boot/health criteria. FAIL on ambiguous/wrong rail/state, incomplete restore/boot, mismatch, lock/MCE/error or evidence gap. Ping loss or final reachability alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Agent never performs physical DC control; gate requires trained operator and electrical approval.
Recovery/observation must survive the selected power loss and data/workloads must be protected.
Stop on any ambiguous power state, unsafe condition, boot/health fault or control loss.
No automatic retry, extra cycle, log clear or power-class substitution.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed DC-versus-S5/count disposition
Baseline boot media, identity, health/stress/RAS/kernel/BMC state
Numbered operator action plus independent power state and unique boot/readiness timeline
Complete per-cycle Basic Health/Post-Boot and error deltas
Final restored state, no-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On ambiguous power state, control loss, incomplete restore/boot or health error, stop and preserve evidence. The agent must not toggle DC or issue another cycle. Use only the signed operator recovery sequence and quarantine until power/platform owner release.
